header.title: RadioGroup
header.description: Groups several Radio controls to pick a single option. Adds a label, helper text, error, orientation and keyboard navigation, and passes `name`, `size`, `tone` and state to each option.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Tweak the props and see the result and code instantly.
playground.label: Notification channel
playground.helperText: Choose how we should reach you.

base.title: Base
base.description: With `label`, `helperText` and `defaultValue`. Each option can have its own `helperText`.

texts.label: Notification channel
texts.helperText: Choose how we should reach you.

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: `orientation="horizontal"` lays the options out in a row.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` locks every option in the group.

disabledOption.title: Disabled option
disabledOption.description: `isDisabled` on a Radio locks only that option.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` marks the group as invalid, forces the error tone on the options and shows the message with role="alert".

texts.label: Payment method
texts.errorMessage: Select a payment method to continue.

required.title: Required
required.description: `isRequired` adds the asterisk, aria-required and required on each input.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` on the group applies to every option.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` on the group sets the size of the options and the message.

keyboard.title: Keyboard navigation
keyboard.description: Tab enters the group, arrow keys change the option and Home/End jump to the first or last enabled one.

texts.label: Theme
texts.helperText: Tab into the group, then use Arrow keys. Home and End jump to the first or last option. Space selects the focused radio.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Drive the selection with `value` and `onChange`, which receives the value and the event.

withTooltip.title: With tooltip
withTooltip.description: Two ways to show the info icon. With `infoText`, the group renders a FieldInfoButton inside the label row, aligned to the right edge of the group; `infoLabel` sets its accessible name and `onInfoClick` its click. The other way is to place your own FieldInfoButton in a flex container next to the group (`content` is the tooltip text): it sits at the top right, outside the group. In both cases the icon goes to the right edge, so limit the container width.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, RadioGroup accepts native <div> attributes (HTMLAttributes) except onChange and defaultValue. className and wrapperClassName go to the same root container. Options are Radio controls: the group passes them name, size, tone, the selected value and the disabled, invalid and required state.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: The container uses role="radiogroup" and is named by the label through aria-labelledby.
a11y.describedBy: helperText or errorMessage are linked through aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".
a11y.states: isInvalid/errorMessage, isRequired and isDisabled add aria-invalid, aria-required and aria-disabled to the group.
a11y.keyboard: Arrow keys use native radio navigation; Home and End focus and select the first or last enabled option.
a11y.noLabel: With no visible label, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Options use the Radio classes.

rules.header: Row with the label and the info icon.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: RadioGroup has no CSS variables of its own: option colors come from the Radio --gem-radio-* variables. The group uses these gem-system tokens.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers. Includes the Radio types.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <div> attributes (except onChange and defaultValue).

items.name: Shared name for the inputs. Generated when omitted.
items.label: Visible group label.
items.helperText: Helper text below the group (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error message. Marks the group as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon next to the label.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.tone: Tone of the options. Forced to error when the group is invalid.
items.isRequired: Marks the group as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.id: Group id and base for internal ids.
items.aria-label: Accessible name when there is no label.
items.className: Extra classes for the root container.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Receives the new value and the event when the selection changes.
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
items.onKeyDown: Keyboard handler on the group. Calling preventDefault disables Home/End.
